name: @dzcalendar/pro-angular
description: DzCalendar Pro for Angular 19+: a dzEventEditor directive on <dz-calendar> (the event and recurrence editor, loaded on its first opening) and the DzExport service (printing, PDF, PNG, XLSX, CSV, ICS, loaded on first use). The timeline views come with `import '@dzcalendar/pro'`. MIT for now (owner's decision).
